assumptions: Task/board files carried a pre-existing 'status: done' / Execution Log from a prior run, but no source files existed on disk in this working copy — treated the spec's own AC text as the source of truth and implemented + verified from scratch rather than trusting the stale log.
os.homedir() on POSIX reads process.env.HOME per call (not cached at process start), so tests override HOME per-test with a fresh temp dir to isolate the real ~/.todo.json from test runs.

StoreReadError uses code E_STORE_READ_FAILED (not specified verbatim in the contract's Error Cases table, which only names StoreCorruptedError's E_STORE_CORRUPTED and StoreWriteError's E_STORE_WRITE_FAILED) — chosen for consistency with the write-error naming convention.
